question: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'US' THEN 'United States'
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'Iran' THEN 'Iran'
    ELSE c.country_or_region
  END as country,
  SUM(CAST(c._4_20_20 AS INT64)) as total_confirmed,
  p.year_2018 as population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CAST(c._4_20_20 AS INT64)) * 100000, p.year_2018), 2) as cases_per_100k
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.confirmed_cases` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` p
  ON (c.country_or_region = 'US' AND p.country = 'United States')
  OR (c.country_or_region = 'Iran' AND p.country = 'Iran, Islamic Rep.')
  OR (c.country_or_region = p.country)
WHERE c.country_or_region IN ('US', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran')
GROUP BY c.country_or_region, p.country, p.year_2018
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'US' THEN 1
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'France' THEN 2
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'China' THEN 3
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'Italy' THEN 4
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'Spain' THEN 5
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'Germany' THEN 6
    WHEN c.country_or_region = 'Iran' THEN 7
  END
